---
description: 'Placeholder backend service used by the platform scaffold. Replace with your own.'
labels: ['placeholder', 'scaffold', 'express', 'server']
---

A scaffold-only REST service used by the platform generator so that newly-created
platforms boot out of the box. It exposes a single `GET /` endpoint that returns
a "replace me" message via the platform gateway.

This component is **not meant for production use** — replace it with your own
backend service in your platform's `.bit-app` file.
